import re

def parse(lines):
    name_re = re.compile(r'^\s*NAME:\s*"(?P<name>[^"]*)"\s*,\s*DESCR:\s*"(?P<descr>.*)"\s*$')
    pid_re = re.compile(r'^\s*PID:\s*(?P<pid>.*?)\s*,\s*VID:\s*(?P<vid>.*?)\s*,\s*SN:\s*(?P<sn>.*?)\s*$')
    records = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = name_re.match(line)
        if m:
            cur = {'NAME': m.group('name'), 'DESCR': m.group('descr'), 'PID': '', 'VID': '', 'SN': ''}
            records.append(cur)
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = pid_re.match(line)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur['PID'] = m.group('pid')
            cur['VID'] = m.group('vid')
            cur['SN'] = m.group('sn')
            used.append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\S+[#>]', line):
            skip.append(i)
    return {'blocks': [{'name': 'inventory', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': records}], 'skip': skip}
